description: Required/optional field schema for Nigerian AV/equipment rental SMEs.

required_fields.label: Equipment Needed
clarifying_question_templates: What equipment do you need — generators, chairs, canopies, PA system, projectors?

required_fields.label: Event Date
clarifying_question_templates: What date do you need the equipment for?

required_fields.label: Delivery Location
clarifying_question_templates: Where should the equipment be delivered?

required_fields.label: Rental Duration (Days)
clarifying_question_templates: How many days do you need the equipment for?

optional_fields.label: Setup / Installation Required
clarifying_question_templates: Do you need us to set up and take down the equipment?

optional_fields.label: Operator Needed
clarifying_question_templates: Will you need an operator (e.g. sound engineer, generator attendant)?

field_completeness_rules.notes: All required fields must be present before a quote can be computed.
